title: Todini multi-loop network
description: Steady two-loop gravity network (Alperovits & Shamir 1977 topology, fixed analysis diameters, Hazen–Williams). Reference heads and flows from a Todini–Pilati gradient solve converged to 1e-12 m, cross-checked against EPANET 2.2 (|ΔH| < 1 mm).

citations.title: A gradient algorithm for the analysis of pipe networks
Design of optimal water distribution systems

criteria.rationale: Worst junction head within 5 cm. The SI Hazen–Williams coefficients in use differ by up to 0.1 % (10.667 here, ≈10.67 from EPANET's US-unit 4.727), which moves heads by at most 0.03 m on this network's 26 m of loss; single-precision output adds about 2 mm at 200 m.

Pipe flows within 0.1 % (relative L2). Flows do not depend on the Hazen–Williams coefficient's absolute value, only on continuity and loop balance; 0.1 % is the default EPANET convergence criterion (sum of flow changes over total flow ≤ 0.001).

convergence.not_applicable: Steady looped network with a closed-form-equivalent reference: there is no grid or time step to refine.
